title: Single post template
description: Customization of the single-post base template (base_html.html). Every group is optional except version and postType: missing values fall back to the defaults defined here. The x-ui annotations describe how the editor builds its sidebar.
$comment: x-ui reference. On objects: layout = section (top-level sidebar group) | subsection (collapsible block inside a section); order = position among siblings; collapsed = initial state; enabledWhen on a section disables all its controls. On fields: control = color | font | segmented | swatch | slider | select | toggle | switch | hidden; order; unit and step for sliders; cssVar = CSS custom property written on :root; cssValue = template for its value ({value}, or {family}/{fallback} for fonts) or a map from the JSON value (booleans as 'true'/'false') to the CSS value; optionsFrom = restrict a select to $defs.fontFamily.x-fontMeta[<family of fonts[<sibling fontRoleField>]>][meta]; enabledWhen = disable the control unless the condition holds: {path, equals} on another value, or {fontRoleField, meta, equals} on the font metadata; derivedFrom = value set automatically from a sibling field's font metadata; onValue/offValue = values of a toggle bound to an enum; icons = render options as icons. Visibility values become 'initial' (shown: var() falls back to the element's own value) or 'none' (hidden).
